messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: alert: spike in 5xx rate from model variant 'omega-canary' in eu-west-1. 90th latency also up ~2x. auto-alert threshold breached at 14:02 UTC
Anya (oncall): seeing it. pulling logs now.
Samir (runtime): reproducing with a small replay — errors are NPEs from kv-cache miss path on quantized shards. looks like recent runtime kernel change might be hitting this variant.
Lia (sre): tagging pager and pausing any ongoing deploys. @Anya do we need to page infra?
Anya (oncall): Paging infra for kernel rollback prep. @Naomi can you surface any customer impact?
Naomi (cust-eng): flagged two customers in eu with higher error rates — they reported failed generations in last 10m. low volume but visible. one is a sandboxed prod trial.
Samir (runtime): plan: immediately dampen traffic to canary to limit blast radius, enable automatic fallback to 'omega-stable-v2' for any errored requests, then either roll back the kernel or evict the quantized shard for canary. prefer to route away first.
Anya (oncall): agree. executing soft-weight change now. will reduce canary weight to 3%.
Anya (oncall): command:
```
# reduce canary weight and set fallback
redwoodctl traffic set-weight --model omega --variant canary --weight 3 --region eu-west-1
redwoodctl feature toggle --name auto_fallback_on_error --model omega --to-variant omega-stable-v2 --region eu-west-1
```
OpsBot: :white_check_mark: traffic weight update queued (run id: tx-9234). expected propagation ~30s.
Anya (oncall): propagated. canary now ~3% in eu-west-1. watching metrics.
Lia (sre): adding temporary keywise soft quotas for heavy keys to prevent noisy neighbors: reducing per-key qps cap to 5 in eu-west-1 for 10m window. command: `redwoodctl quota update --scope key --cap 5 --region eu-west-1`
Samir (runtime): on fallback, we should ensure tokenization and model signature compatibility — stable variant is compatible. enabling fallback now.
OpsBot: :information_source: auto_fallback_on_error enabled for omega in eu-west-1.
Anya (oncall): metrics: error rate dropped by ~78% in 2m after weight change, latencies trending down. customers still seeing few failures. Naomie — any update?
Naomi (cust-eng): one customer reported intermittent failures; their traffic was heavily routed to eu-west-1. suggested workaround: use regional routing to us-east-1 if urgent. offering to open a support ticket.
Samir (runtime): given the kernel change is suspected, I'm going to evict the quantized shard from the canary nodes as a soft mitigation while we validate a rollback. this avoids disabling the whole variant. eviction command: `runtimectl shard evict --model omega --variant canary --shard q-17 --region eu-west-1`
Anya (oncall): proceed. coordinate oncall window with infra. Lia — please hold autoscaler and any batch jobs that might resubmit load to canary.
Lia (sre): done. paused autoscaler for affected pool. also pinned stable capacity to absorb extra load.
Samir (runtime): eviction completed; logs show shard fallback to host-level cold-cache but no NPEs so far. continuing soak test.
IncidentBot: note: page rotation due at 14:30 UTC. current page: Anya (oncall). next: Lia (sre).
Anya (oncall): handing off to Lia for the 15m soak. Lia, everything you need is in the ops playbook and ops runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/omega-canary-issue
Lia (sre): thanks. I'm taking over. will keep canary at 3% until we confirm kernel rollback or full patch.
Naomi (cust-eng): I'll message the two impacted customers with status: reduced failures, fallbacks to stable in place, we're working on root cause and will provide ETA for rollback.
Samir (runtime): quick note on rollback: if kernel rollback is selected, we need a coordinated maintenance window since it touches multiple pools. prep checklist created. If rollback >10m, prefer to fully disable the canary variant to avoid partial divergence.
Lia (sre): agree. if errors resurface during soak, we'll demote canary to 0% and flip a temporary block to prevent new allocations. command to disable: `redwoodctl traffic set-weight --model omega --variant canary --weight 0 --region eu-west-1 && redwoodctl feature toggle --name prevent_new_allocations --model omega --variant canary --on`
Anya (oncall): noted. will keep the incident channel updated. logging timeline for postmortem. :memo:
OpsBot: :bell: reminder scheduled: postmortem doc due in 48h at /incidents/2478123456-postmortem.
Lia (sre): monitoring looks stable for now. leaving fallback and quotas in place for 30 more minutes before considering incrementing canary back to 10% slowly.
Samir (runtime): continuing root cause analysis — will attach repro and kernel diff to the postmortem. thanks all.
Naomi (cust-eng): customers acknowledged workaround, no immediate escalation. closing loop with them after postmortem.
Anya (oncall): incident moved to "monitoring". if anything spikes we re-open the page. good job team. :thumbsup:
